description:
There is no plan B.

Not because failure isn’t possible…but because going back to who I used to be isn’t.

Sometimes the only way forward is to burn the bridge behind you.
transcript: When you want to accomplish something big, something out of your comfort zone, that next level that you've been craving, then screw plan B. Make everything, all of your energy plan A. Burn the boats, knock the wall down, go through the pain, go through whatever it takes, and put all the focuses like, no, there's no plan B. This is my life.
